text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Even so, the result doesn't change.
I was being naive.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: To think it was such... a punishing race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder.
Though, I do want to run soon."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"I will seize 1st place in the next Derby
so that it doesn't end in such a pathetic display...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian headed toward the waiting room,
her bushy tail swishing vigorously back and forth.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, did you manage to get
good photos of Narita Brian?

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
It came out perfectly! The moment of acceleration
was captured clearly on camera!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Still, you gotta feel bad for the rest of their generation...
To have someone like that show up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A passing snippet of conversation between reporters.
It was only the next day that I remembered it.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see?
The news about the recent Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"I saw it. The one in first place, sure, but...
what on earth was that monster?
My girl was aiming for the Derby, too..."

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian's run really was
a total shocker, wasn't it...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Have you seen it? That article.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? "The closest runner to becoming the Derby Umamusume.
The monster, Brian, and her astounding acceleration."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: "Hey, did you see that? She was a straight-up monster on that final stretch."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
It's Brian, right? Wonder if she's running in the Derby too.
I just got in touch with my Trainer to ask about that.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Narita Brian, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
...It's pretty noisy out there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Where Narita Brian points, a crowd of people has lined up just to catch a glimpse of her.
choice_data_list: Maybe it's because of that news article...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... What a pain.
Spectators are always such a nuisance.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Still, I cannot be bothered with every little thing.
At the next Classic Triple Crown race, the Japanese Derby, I will win...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as the expectations around Narita Brian soared,
her mind was focused solely on her next goal:
the Nippon Derby.
